notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You have gained at least four life this turn.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate the Accomplished Alchemist token's second ability by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
